newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open lower after Dow's sharp fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open lower after Dow's sharp fall.

text.p: Tokyo stocks dropped at the open on Thursday, as sentiment was hit by a sell-off in U.S. stocks overnight, brokers said.
But they said that the index was likely to stop falling at around 20,200 to 20,300 today.
At 0014 GMT, the Nikkei 225 average was down 198.94 points, or 0.97 percent, to 20,369.44. Its December futures were 170 points lower at 20,400.
Brokers said nearby support for the Nikkei index stood at 20,171.69, the day's low on December 6 when it plunged more than 650 points.
